tagging.baseline: out/tags.json (v1) is unchanged; v2 = v1 with place/weather/activity re-tagged and interaction/food_visible added
tagging.note: All 1,579 cards were re-looked (not only a candidate subset), so no random control sample was needed; see candidateFilterCheck.

candidateFilterCheck.filter: coordinator candidate rule applied to v1 tags
candidateFilterCheck.explanation: Changes outside the filter were cosmetic (e.g. weather none-visible->clear, place plain-background->abstract); none produced kitchen/space/volcano/lightning/rain.

selfCheck.reviewer: the orchestrating Claude session (not the Sonnet taggers), fresh contact sheets of each top 8 (temp files, deleted afterwards)
selfCheck.rule: same rule as v1: a hit counts if the drawn scene matches; borderline counts as a miss; empty top-8 slots count as misses

misses: sm1-64 (Cosmog on a cliff, not space)
hgss1-26 (the flower is part of the Pokémon, no flowers in the scene)
only 2 results in total: the re-tag marked just 1 card as playing-together
sv01-218 (no human visible in the whole-card thumbnail)
only 1 card in the whole set was tagged kitchen; swsh1-89 (tea cups on a counter) was not
